svg.title: coderprint: 702k lines of code in use, of 1.3M written, all time
svg.desc: 702,483 lines of code in use (470,745 in production, 231,738 in tests), of 1,310,870 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 3,275 commits across all branches, 65 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 10 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 1.2M lines of code. The bars end on 27OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 57%, Lean 21%, Python 12%, TypeScript 6%, JavaScript 3%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 54% is kept.
